text: Nee how means hello in China!
Where should we go next, Kaylee?
Light up the lanterns to start the parade!
The dragon parade is coming soon!
Kaylee, you did it! You won the China Explorer trophy!
Aiyo! So many hungry friends, and no helper!
Slide the basket to your friend!
Pull off a piece. Big or small?
Hot water makes steam. Steam cooks dumplings!
Drag the filling onto the dough!
Run your finger round the edge!
Drag the dumpling to the basket!
Drag the basket to your friend!
Drag a dough ball to the board!
Ho ho ho! A dumpling pancake!
Mmm! How chir! I love dumplings!
Uh oh! Tap the sneaky monkey!
Tap tap on the table means thank you for the tea!
Your dumplings go in the window!
Shanghai is the biggest city in China!
The Pearl Tower! It looks like pink pearls on a stick!
Swipe up! Grow it three tall!
Make this one taller than that one!
Taller! And that one is shorter!
Which one is the tallest? Tap it!
Which one is the shortest? Tap it!
Bao Bao climbs the tallest bamboo!
Oops! I knocked bricks off the Great Wall!
The wall is so long! Slide it to see more!
Slide the wall, or tap the arrow!
Hou Hou ran ahead! Follow him!
Red, gold, red, gold... what comes next?
Red, gold, gold, red, gold... what comes next?
Red, gold, jade, red... what comes next?
Hee hee! The wall is getting strong!
Hooray! The whole wall is fixed!
Tap the tower to light the signal fire!
Soldiers sent smoke signals tower to tower!
The message zoomed along the wall!
Hotpot time, Kaylee! Everybody cooks together!
Hong wants something green from the mild side!
Tap a food, then tap the soup!
Tap the noodles, then tap the soup!
The mild side is the white soup!
Tap the chopsticks, then tap the sparkly food!
People in China eat with chopsticks!
Spin the table with your finger!
Spin the table to Bao Bao!
Spin the table to Nai Nai!
Everyone shares one pot in the middle!
A round table means everybody can reach!
Sichuan peppers make your lips tingle!
This magic brush makes pictures come alive!
Paint a person! Follow the glowing line.
Try again! Follow the glowing line.
The water writing fades away, but the picture stays!
Now paint your name, Kaylee! In Chinese!
Your name, stamped with a red seal, Kaylee!
Chinese isn't written with letters. Some characters started as pictures!
The Jade Emperor is holding a big race across the river!
Mouse can't swim! Put Mouse on Ox's back!
Tiger swims across all by himself!
Rabbit hops! Put stones in the glowing spots!
Put a stone on a glowing spot!
I stopped to make rain for a thirsty village!
Tap the clouds to make it rain!
Everybody wins a step! Who came first?
Who came first? Put Mouse on the first step!
Who came second? Put that animal on the second step!
Who came third? Put that animal on the third step!
Now the last two! Who came fourth?
Ox carried Mouse. Ox came second!
Rabbit hopped over the stones. Rabbit came fourth!
Dragon stopped to make rain. Dragon came fifth!
Who came right after Ox? Tap that animal!
Tiger came right after Ox! Tap the glowing one!
Yes! Tiger came right after Ox!
There are twelve zodiac animals, one for every year!
Kaylee, you were born in the Year of the Ox!
Kaylee, you were born in the Year of the Rat!
This year, 2026, is the Year of the Horse!
Shh! Someone is sleeping. Tap the cat!
The cat overslept and missed the race! That is why there is no Year of the Cat!
China is so big! Let's ride the super-fast train!
Push the lever up to zoom!
China has some of the fastest trains in the world!
China is so big! Snowy in the north, sunny beach in the south!
Harbin! It is far up north. Brrr, snow!
Hainan! It is far down south. So hot!
The Gobi Desert! Sunny days and chilly nights!
The Himalayas! The tallest mountains in the world!
The tiger is shivering! Give him the scarf!
Get Bao Bao ready for the beach!
It is a hot, sunny day! What does Bao Bao need?
Now it is night, and cold! What does Bao Bao need?
Which one fits the tall, snowy mountains?
A swim ring in the snow? Silly!
A blanket in the hot sun? Silly!
Mittens in the desert sun? Silly!
A sun hat at night? Silly!
I am not thirsty. I am cold!
A sun hat on a snowy mountain? Silly!
A swim ring on a mountain? Silly!
What a trip! Thank you, Kaylee!
I'm Long Long! Let's dance, Kaylee!
Drag Long Long around the lanterns!
Shyeh shyeh for fixing the wall!
Shyeh shyeh for the magic brush!
Shyeh shyeh for the train ride!
Tap the drum! Make the dragon dance!
Tap the sky to make fireworks!
Tap the flag to raise it!
China's flag is red, with one big gold star and four little stars!
Bao Bao has a red envelope! Tap to open it!
A red envelope is called a hong bao!
Sheen nyen kwy luh, Kaylee! Happy New Year!
Want to see the real Great Wall?
Want to hear the Great Race story?
Wow, a city made of ice!
Let's float down the Li River!
Giant panda sticker! Panda babies are born as tiny as a stick of butter!
Golden monkey sticker! These monkeys have sky-blue faces!
Pekingese sticker! These puppies from China look like tiny lions!
Red panda sticker! Red pandas stand up tall when they are surprised!
Crane sticker! Red-crowned cranes dance to say hello!
Ox sticker! You were born in the Year of the Ox!
Tiger sticker! Amur tigers live where it is snowy and cold!
In China, people say nee how! It means hello!
Shanghai is the biggest city in China! It has a tower with pink balls!
Soup dumplings come from Shanghai. There is soup inside!
Dim sum is lots of little dishes, shared with tea.
Chinese New Year has lanterns, dragons and red envelopes!
Giant pandas live in the bamboo mountains of China.
The Great Wall of China is super long!
China is a huge country with snowy places and sunny beaches!
One, two, three in Chinese: ee, are, san!
In China, red is the color of luck and happiness!
Chinese dragons are kind! They bring rain and good luck.
Paper, kites and fireworks were first made in China!
More people live in China than almost anywhere in the world!
This is China! Tap a picture to learn more.
